description: This file defines a PHP class `Extension` within the `Opencart\Admin\Controller\Startup` namespace. The class extends the base controller and has an `index()` method that loads extension information from the database, registers various extension components (controllers, models, libraries), and adds directory paths for templates, languages, and configurations based on installed extensions.

classes.name: Extension
classes.description: Controller class responsible for initializing and registering extension components during startup.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads installed extensions from the database, then registers controllers, models, library, and directory paths for each extension.
